title: CFPC Structure Contract
description: Composition contract. Declares document hierarchy (containment graph) and symbol references (dependency graph) as separate edge sets. Not an execution arm.

@id.description: Unique identifier for this structure contract.

@template.description: Template to validate against. Only 'article.v1' is registered at Stage 7.

@contains.description: Containment edges. Validated for cycles and role ordering.

@depends.description: Dependency edges for symbol resolution. Carried for CFPC; never cycle-checked by structure validator.

@policy.description: Policy block. containment_implies_dependency=true is rejected at parse time.

containment_implies_dependency.description: MUST NOT be true. Rejected by Pattern Induction Guard.
